notes: Curated regional radar additions omitted from the first migration. All factual event metadata below was checked against official venue pages on 2026-08-14. Prices are included only when published by the official venue.

events.subtitle: The Piano Quintet feat. PUBLIQuartet
events.factual_description: Blue Note New York lists Hiromi: The Piano Quintet feat. PUBLIQuartet for Aug 20–23, 2026, with 8:00 PM and 10:30 PM sets each night.

en.why_it_matters: One of the defining Japanese jazz artists of her generation in a chamber-jazz format that puts composition, virtuosity and acoustic detail ahead of spectacle.
en.trip_verdict: Worth the New York trip if the piano-quintet format is the draw; this is more distinctive than a routine tour stop.

es.why_it_matters: Una de las figuras esenciales del jazz japonés de su generación en un formato de cámara que privilegia composición, virtuosismo y detalle acústico por encima del espectáculo.
es.trip_verdict: Sí puede justificar Nueva York si atrae el formato de quinteto con cuerdas: es bastante más singular que una parada convencional de gira.

events.subtitle: Remembering Kiyoshi Kitagawa feat. Yasushi Nakamura & Clarence Penn
events.factual_description: Birdland lists Makoto Ozone Trio ‘Remembering Kiyoshi Kitagawa’ featuring Yasushi Nakamura and Clarence Penn from Aug 25–29, 2026. Tue–Thu sets are 7:00 and 9:30 PM; Fri–Sat sets are 8:30 and 10:30 PM.

en.why_it_matters: A major Japanese pianist in an intimate New York club, using the trio format to remember bassist Kiyoshi Kitagawa. The context and personnel make this more than a generic Ozone engagement.
en.trip_verdict: Strong New York trip candidate, especially for the Japanese-jazz thread of Listening Notes.

es.why_it_matters: Uno de los grandes pianistas japoneses en un club íntimo de Nueva York, con un trío concebido para recordar al bajista Kiyoshi Kitagawa. El contexto y la formación lo vuelven mucho más que una fecha rutinaria de Ozone.
es.trip_verdict: Candidato fuerte para justificar Nueva York, sobre todo dentro del hilo japonés de Listening Notes.

sources.note: Official lineup, showtimes and published ticket range.

events.subtitle: featuring Bill Frisell, Larry Grenadier & Kweku Sumbry
events.factual_description: NJPAC lists the Charles Lloyd Quartet at the Victoria Theater on Saturday, Nov 21, 2026 at 3:00 PM, featuring Bill Frisell, Larry Grenadier and Kweku Sumbry.

en.why_it_matters: An 88-year-old living master with Bill Frisell in a compact theater: historical weight, a rare lineup and a setting small enough for the music’s nuance to matter.
en.trip_verdict: Yes. This is exactly the kind of performance that justifies the train to Newark.

es.why_it_matters: Un maestro vivo de 88 años junto a Bill Frisell en un teatro compacto: peso histórico, una formación poco común y una sala suficientemente íntima para que importen todos los matices.
es.trip_verdict: Sí. Es exactamente el tipo de concierto que justifica subirse al tren a Newark.
